notes.title: Small Hotfix Patch v1.13

tags.bug: - Fixed several glitches that made the player arms sprites get set incorrectly for a frame when aiming;

tags.balance_change: - Decreased enemy movement and flying speed max scaling;

tags.feature: - Players will now wall jump on structures when aiming.

notes.title: Small Hotfix v1.12
notes.content: - Improved the zombie desync detection code. Specially impactful for players with high ping variation/packet loss to experience a smoother experience.

tags.bug: - Improved the zombie desync detection code. Specially impactful for players with high ping variation/packet loss to experience a smoother experience.

notes.title: One Last Try Patch v1.1 Update

tags.feature:
* New weapon: GGS1

The game's first Automatic Sniper Rifle comes with 10 bullets per magazine and a reduced price compared to its DPS to compensate for how fast you're going to go through Heavy Ammo Bullets.

tags.bug: - Wizard Zombie projectile attack will only travel for 300 Units instead of only stopping on collision;

tags.feature: - Wizard Zombie projectile attack can now be destroyed by Melee Attacks;

tags.balance_change: - Wizard Zombie projectile speed reduced by 20% to allow better counter-play;
- Reduced Stalker zombie initial HP from 2000 to 1200;
- Greatly increased the chance for Special zombies to drop ammunition in Survival Mode;
- Drastically increased the chance for Special zombies to drop ammunition in Chaos Mode;
- Changes to the enemy spawn rate and leveling on Chaos Mode should reduce the difficulty curve on the first few minutes of the match.

notes.title: October 8th Hotfix (v1.02)

tags.feature: - Players will aim automatically with firearm equipped;

tags.balance_change: - Increased accuracy with all Assault Rifles;

notes.title: October 7th Launch Hotfix (v1.01)
notes.content:
- Reduced difficulty of Survival Mode (enemy spawn rate);
- Added a $1500 starting cash per player on Survival mode;
